notes:
Tier 1 (direct HTTP fetch of SSR HTML) was sufficient throughout; this is a Magento site whose PLPs are server-rendered with a Mirasvit 'power-listing' toolbar exposing an exact '
N Item(s)
' total, so no Playwright/CDP was needed. robots.txt (https://ochomefurniture.com/ae-en/robots.txt) has no Claude-specific disallow, only standard Allow:/ plus admin/checkout/filter-param excludes. Discovery method: fetched robots.txt-listed sitemaps (sitemapoc.xml = ae-en/UAE, sitemapocuaearab.xml = ae-ar/UAE Arabic) and grepped for christmas/xmas/halloween/diwali/easter/valentine/thanksgiving/new-year/eid/ramadan/festive/festival/seasonal/holiday; also crawled the homepage mega-menu (Furniture/Homeware/Lighting/etc. - no seasonal nodes live there) and homepage promo banners (currently promoting Ramadan Collection sub-links). Arabic sitemap mirrors the English one 1:1 with no unique categories. No Diwali, Halloween, Easter, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, or New Year category pages exist anywhere in either sitemap or nav - absence confirmed by full sitemap keyword sweep, not just site search. Two genuine holiday families found: Christmas and Ramadan. CHRISTMAS: 'Christmas Collection' (/ae-en/christmas-collection, power-listing count 75) is a real parent PLP whose 4 real sub-category PLPs (festive-furniture=3, festive-homeware=36, christmas-trees=1, christmas-decors=34; sum=74~=75) partition it almost exactly, so the parent is recorded as a grouping row (is_group, qty/link null) and the 4 children as leaf rows, each confirmed Christmas-themed via meta description (Christmas trees/balls/Santa/snowman/ornaments etc.). A second, separate top-level entry point '/ae-en/festive-decor' (count 83, reached via a different URL tree, likely Homeware>Decor&Arts) also lists exclusively Christmas products (christmas-ball-set-of-*, christmas-decoration-*, christmas-tree-45cm, etc. - verified by comparing product-item-link hrefs) and is NOT an identical duplicate of christmas-collection (different counts: 83 vs 75), so per the dup rule (only skip when count+facets are identical) it is kept as its own row rather than folded in; its own sub-page /festive-decor/decor (45 items) was confirmed to be a strict subset of /festive-decor by product-link overlap and was therefore excluded as redundant/double-counting rather than given its own row. RAMADAN: no bare '/ae-en/ramadan-collection' page exists (that path 404s to the generic homepage title), so Ramadan has two independent top-level parents instead of one master group: 'Ramadan Furniture' (own count 40; 5 children sofas=13/dining=2/coffee-tables=8/side-tables=8/majlis=5, sum=36~=40) and 'Ramadan Homeware' (own count 115; 8 children drinkware=22/dinnerware=13/serveware=12/wall-decor=1/fragrances=25/cushions=7/home-decor=7/kahwa-tea-sets=8, sum=95~=115) - both parents recorded as grouping rows, children as leaf rows. Each Ramadan child's meta description explicitly frames it as Ramadan decor/furniture 'crafted for welcoming Ramadan season/celebrations', confirming genuine site-endorsed seasonal categorization; these are also the exact sub-links the site currently promotes on its live homepage banner. EXCLUDED as storewide sale/clearance pages, not genuine seasonal categories (per the explicit Ramadan/Eid-timed-sale boundary rule): 'eid-sale1' family (top=262, furniture=23, homeware=238, kids=1) - generic default site meta description (no Eid-specific copy) and its product sample (tajine, laundry hampers, tumblers, dinner plates) is ordinary catalog merchandise, not Eid-themed; 'ramadan-night-souq' (37) and 'ramadan-night-sale' family (7/7/0), plus their alternate URL '/kids-bedroom-mirror/ramadan-souq-furniture' (0) and '/kids-bedroom-mirror/ramadan-souq-homeware' (37) - same generic default meta description as eid-sale1 and generic product samples (yoga bag, soap dispenser, desk organiser, dinner knife, ceramic decor bowl) with no Ramadan theming; both families read as timed discount promos layered over ordinary catalog SKUs. Also excluded as non-PLP pages: '/ae-en/the-ramadan-edit-oman' (editorial 'Design Ideas | Tips' page, no product grid/count, and Oman-market content anyway) and '/ae-en/ramadan-catalogue-2026' (no product grid, no count div - a catalog/lookbook landing page).
